app.name: Gainee
app.description: Turn articles into IELTS lessons: vocabulary, exercises, spaced repetition and progress tracking.

errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes.

dashboard.intro: Import an article, read it in short parts, and keep your streak going.

jobs.title: Background jobs
jobs.intro: AI lesson generation will run here. Press the button to check that the worker is working.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.placeholder: Type an English word or phrase…
dictionary.askAiHint: Tip: in the reader you can ask the AI to explain words that are not in the dictionary.
dictionary.info: {name} · {entries, number} entries · works offline, no AI needed
dictionary.notImported: No dictionary imported yet – see README → “Offline dictionary”.

install.title: Install Gainee on this device
install.android: Open it like a normal app – full screen, from your home screen.
install.ios: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

reader.tryIntro: Tap any word – or select a word or short phrase – to see its meaning from the offline dictionary. No AI is used.

labels.title: Categories
labels.intro: Create your own topics, sources and labels, then attach them to texts and words to filter and review by group.

topic.title: Topics
topic.hint: What a text or word is about. Topics can have sub-topics (up to 3 levels).

source.title: Sources
source.hint: Where it came from: a magazine, website, book or test.

custom.title: My labels
custom.hint: Anything else: “must-know for the exam”, “phrasal verbs”, “Speaking Part 2”…

labels.counts: {documents, plural, =0 {no texts} one {# text} other {# texts}} · {words, plural, =0 {no words} one {# word} other {# words}}
labels.name: Name
labels.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}”? It will be removed from all texts and words (they are not deleted).

errors.duplicate: A label with this name already exists.
errors.too_deep: Topics can only be nested 3 levels deep.
errors.cycle: A topic cannot be inside itself.
errors.parent_only_for_topics: Only topics can have a parent.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.title: Learning profile
profile.hint: Used by the AI to choose vocabulary and to write explanations.

providers.title: AI providers
providers.hint: Add one or more providers. Keys are encrypted before they are stored. All of them use the OpenAI-compatible API.
providers.label: Name
providers.newKey: New API key (leave empty to keep)
providers.modelNote: Model names change often – press “Test” after saving to load the list of models your key can use.
providers.invalid: Please check the fields (the API key must be at least 8 characters).

routing.title: Model for each task
routing.hint: Use a cheap, fast model for quick questions and a stronger one for lessons and writing feedback. A fallback is used automatically if the main one fails.

lesson_generate.title: Lesson generation
lesson_generate.hint: Builds lessons, vocabulary and exercises from imported texts. Needs good JSON output.

reader_quick.title: Quick questions in the reader
reader_quick.hint: Explain a word or sentence, grammar, translate, paraphrase. Fast and cheap is best.

writing_grade.title: Writing feedback
writing_grade.hint: IELTS band and corrections for paraphrases and essays.

import.heading: Add a new text
import.intro: Upload a PDF / Word file or paste an article. It is cleaned, split into short lessons, and the AI prepares vocabulary and exercises for each part.
import.drop: Drop a file here or tap to choose
import.formats: PDF, DOCX or TXT · up to 25 MB
import.title: Title
import.titleHint: Leave empty to detect it automatically
import.author: Author
import.sourceHint: e.g. The New Yorker, BBC, Cambridge IELTS 18
import.labels: Categories (optional – the AI will also suggest topics)
import.aiNote: Lessons are generated in the background – you can start reading as soon as the first one is ready.

errors.empty: Paste some text or choose a file.
errors.too_short: The text is too short (at least ~80 words).
errors.unsupported_file: Only PDF, DOCX and TXT files are supported.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 25 MB.
errors.cannot_read_file: This file could not be read.
errors.no_text_in_pdf: No text found – the PDF may be a scanned image.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

document.generating: The AI is preparing your lessons…
document.generatingHint: You can leave this page – generation continues in the background.
document.confirmDelete: Delete this text and all its lessons, notes and progress?

lesson.notFoundInText: Could not find that quote in the text

read.hint: Tap a word to look it up · select text to highlight, note or ask AI
read.wpmSlow: Try skimming for the main idea first.
read.wpmOk: Good pace – IELTS needs about 200–250 wpm.
read.wpmFast: Fast! Make sure you understood it.
read.marginHint: Select any text to highlight it or add a note – notes appear here, next to the line.
read.unhighlightConfirm: This highlight has a note. Delete both?

tool.notConfigured: No AI provider is set up yet.
tool.choose: What do you want from the AI?
tool.cardFailed: The AI reply could not be read as a card. Press Generate to try again.

vocab.mine: Words you saved from this lesson ({n})

ex.tip: True = the text says so · False = the text says the opposite · Not Given = the text does not say. Use only the text, not your own knowledge.
ex.gaps: Complete the sentences (you may need to change the word form)

practice.paraphraseHint: Rewrite the sentence in your own words, then compare with the model or ask the AI for feedback.
practice.speakingPlaceholder: Write your answer or an outline, then say it aloud for 1–2 minutes…
practice.notConfigured: Set up an AI provider in Settings to get feedback.
practice.notesPlaceholder: Main ideas in your own words, questions, things to remember…

edit.title: Edit lesson text
edit.help: Delete unrelated parts (author, date, links…), fix the text, apply bold/italic/UPPERCASE, add images. Use the ✂ button where a new lesson should start.
edit.regenerate: Regenerate vocabulary and exercises from the new text
edit.mergeConfirm: Merge with the next lesson and regenerate the exercises?
edit.failed: Could not save, please try again

lesson.askAssistant: Ask the assistant about this text
lesson.resizeSplit: Drag to resize · double-click to reset

editor.heading: Heading
editor.uploadFailed: Could not upload the image (PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP, up to 8 MB)

wordList.title: Saved words
wordList.empty: No saved words yet. Tap a word while reading, then ☆.
wordList.total: {n} saved words, grouped by text and lesson
wordList.imagesHint: Paste (Ctrl/Cmd+V), drop or pick images – PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP up to 8 MB.
wordList.imageFailed: Some images could not be added.

review.title: Today's review
review.due: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing due right now} one {# word due} other {# words due}}
review.nothing: Nothing to review right now. Save words while reading and they will show up here.
review.noMeaning: No meaning saved – edit this word in Saved words.

progress.title: Progress
progress.noReading: Press “Finish reading” at the end of a lesson to record your speed.
progress.noAnswers: Do some exercises to see your accuracy.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.intro: Ask anything about English, IELTS or one of your texts. Conversations are saved.
assistant.placeholder: Ask a question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
assistant.notConfigured: No AI provider is set up yet.

suggest.s1: How can I paraphrase better in IELTS Reading?
suggest.s3: Give me 5 advanced linking words for Writing Task 2

goals.offHint: Set 0 to turn a goal off.
